name: LineChart.data
description: Data array - each item should have a date field and numeric values

name: LineChart.xDataKey
description: Key in data for the x-axis (date). Default: "date"

name: LineChart.margin
description: Chart margins

name: LineChart.animationDuration
description: Animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 1100

name: LineChart.animationEasing
description: CSS easing for clip-reveal. Default: cubic-bezier(0.85, 0, 0.15, 1)

name: LineChart.enterTransition
description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

name: LineChart.revealSignature
description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers reveal replay when it changes.

name: LineChart.aspectRatio
description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

name: LineChart.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: LineChart.status
description: Loading vs ready — drives chart phase and loading chrome. Default: `"ready"`.

name: LineChart.loadingLabel
description: Centered shimmer label while loading.

name: LineChart.yDomainTweenDuration
description: Animate y-domain over this duration (ms) on status transitions. Default: 500.

name: LineChart.yDomain
description: Optional explicit Y bounds. Out-of-range observations remain visible.

name: LineChart.yDomainTween
description: Animate y-domain when status or target domain changes. Default: true

name: LineChart.xDomain
description: Visible x-domain for brush zoom.

name: LineChart.xDomainSlotCount
description: Full dataset length for x-scale padding when `xDomain` is set.

name: LineChart.tweenYDomainOnXDomainChange
description: Tween y-domain when brush changes the visible x-range. Default: false

name: LineChart.style
description: Inline container styles (e.g. fixed height for brush strip).

name: LineChart.onPhaseChange
description: Fires when the internal chart phase changes (e.g. OG capture readiness).

name: LineChart.children
description: Child components (Line, Grid, ChartTooltip, etc.)

name: Line.dataKey
description: Key in data to use for y values

name: Line.yAxisId
description: Y-scale group id (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

name: Line.stroke
description: Stroke color. Default: var(--chart-1)

name: Line.strokeWidth
description: Stroke width. Default: 2.5

name: Line.curve
description: Curve function. Default: curveNatural

name: Line.animate
description: Whether to animate the line. Default: true

name: Line.fadeEdges
description:
Fade the line stroke toward transparent at the chart edges.
- `true` fades both edges, `false` disables the fade entirely.
- `"left"` / `"right"` fades only that side.
Default: true

name: Line.showHighlight
description: Whether to show highlight segment on hover. Default: true

name: Line.showMarkers
description: Render scatter-style circle markers at each data point. Default: false

name: Line.markers
description: Marker styling (same options as Scatter).

name: Line.dashFromIndex
description:
Data index from which the line stroke becomes dashed (inclusive).
Useful for projecting incomplete periods, e.g. dashed from yesterday through today.

name: Line.dashArray
description: Dash pattern for the tail segment when `dashFromIndex` is set. Default: "6,4"

name: Line.loading
description:
Show the loading pulse overlay. Default: follows chart loading phase.
Set `false` to disable even during loading.

name: Line.loadingStroke
description: Stroke color for the loading pulse overlay. Default: var(--fg-default)

name: Line.loadingStrokeOpacity
description: Loading pulse stroke opacity. Default: 0.5

name: Line.loadingPulseMode
description: Override pulse animation mode (loop / exit / enter).

name: Line.onLoadingPulseCycleComplete
description: Called when a loop-mode pulse cycle completes.

name: Line.loadingStyle
description:
Loading animation while the chart is in loading status: the default
traveling `"pulse"`, or a diagonal `"sweep"` shimmer across the skeleton
line. Default: `"pulse"`.

name: LineChartLoading.margin
description: Chart margins

name: LineChartLoading.stroke
description: Stroke color for the animated loading segment.

name: LineChartLoading.strokeOpacity
description: Stroke opacity for the animated loading segment. Default: 0.5

name: LineChartLoading.gridStroke
description: Grid line stroke (color and opacity via color-mix or oklch alpha).

name: LineChartLoading.gridShimmerStroke
description: Shimmer band stroke (color and opacity via color-mix or oklch alpha).

name: LineChartLoading.gridShimmer
description: Animate a shimmer band across grid lines. Default: true

name: LineChartLoading.gridShimmerLength
description: Shimmer band width in pixels. Default: 140

name: LineChartLoading.gridShimmerSpeed
description: Shimmer speed multiplier (higher = faster). Default: 1

name: LineChartLoading.gridShimmerSync
description: Match shimmer loop to the loading line pulse (cycle + inter-loop pause).

name: LineChartLoading.loadingStyle
description:
Loading animation: `"pulse"` (default traveling pulse) or `"sweep"` (a
diagonal shimmer across the skeleton line). Default: `"pulse"`.

name: LineChartLoading.label
description: Centered shimmer label text. Default: "Loading"

name: LineChartLoading.aspectRatio
description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

name: LineChartLoading.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.dataKey
description: Required composition API.

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.yAxisId
description: Optional composition API.

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.fill
description: Optional composition API.

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.stroke
description: Optional composition API.

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.radius
description: Optional composition API.

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.ringGap
description: Optional composition API.

name: LineSeriesTerminalMarker.strokeWidth
description: Optional composition API.
